examples_template.query_generation:
Examples (grounded in the connected graph schema):

Example 1:
User Query: "Starting from the MolecularFunction whose name is "IgA receptor activity", which BiologicalProcess are reachable via a Exposure that is EXPOSURE_MOLFUNC then EXPOSURE_BIOPROCESS?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (a:MolecularFunction {name: "IgA receptor activity"})-[r1:EXPOSURE_MOLFUNC]->(b:Exposure), (b)-[r2:EXPOSURE_BIOPROCESS]->(c:BiologicalProcess) RETURN a, r1, b, r2, c

Example 2:
User Query: "Starting from the Drug whose name is "Copper", which Anatomy are reachable through a GeneProtein (DRUG_PROTEIN), then a GeneProtein (PROTEIN_PROTEIN), then ANATOMY_PROTEIN_ABSENT?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (a:Drug {name: "Copper"})-[r1:DRUG_PROTEIN]->(b:GeneProtein), (b)-[r2:PROTEIN_PROTEIN]->(c:GeneProtein), (c)-[r3:ANATOMY_PROTEIN_ABSENT]->(d:Anatomy) RETURN a, r1, b, r2, c, r3, d

Example 3:
User Query: "Which EffectPhenotype are connected via DISEASE_PHENOTYPE_POSITIVE to the Disease whose name is "hyperemesis gravidarum (disease)"?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:Disease {name: "hyperemesis gravidarum (disease)"})-[r:DISEASE_PHENOTYPE_POSITIVE]->(t:EffectPhenotype) RETURN s, r, t

Example 4:
User Query: "Which GeneProtein are connected via PATHWAY_PROTEIN to the Pathway whose name is "PI3K Cascade"?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:Pathway {name: "PI3K Cascade"})-[r:PATHWAY_PROTEIN]->(t:GeneProtein) RETURN s, r, t

Example 5:
User Query: "Which MolecularFunction are MOLFUNC_MOLFUNC to BOTH the MolecularFunction with name "5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity" AND the MolecularFunction with name "methyltransferase activity"?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:MolecularFunction)-[r1:MOLFUNC_MOLFUNC]->(t1:MolecularFunction {name: "5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity"}), (s)-[r2:MOLFUNC_MOLFUNC]->(t2:MolecularFunction {name: "methyltransferase activity"}) RETURN s, r1, t1, r2, t2

Example 6:
User Query: "Which CellularComponent commonly CELLCOMP_PROTEIN the GeneProtein "ASDURF" and "PHYHIP"?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:CellularComponent)-[r1:CELLCOMP_PROTEIN]->(t1:GeneProtein {name: "ASDURF"}), (s)-[r2:CELLCOMP_PROTEIN]->(t2:GeneProtein {name: "PHYHIP"}) RETURN s, r1, t1, r2, t2

examples_llm.query_generation:
Examples (grounded in the connected graph schema):

Example 1:
User Query: "Which exposures are associated with the molecular function 'IgA receptor activity' and what biological processes are those exposures linked to?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (a:MolecularFunction {name: "IgA receptor activity"})-[r1:EXPOSURE_MOLFUNC]->(b:Exposure), (b)-[r2:EXPOSURE_BIOPROCESS]->(c:BiologicalProcess) RETURN a, r1, b, r2, c

Example 2:
User Query: "Which proteins does copper target that interact with other proteins that are absent from specific anatomical locations, and what are those anatomical locations?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (a:Drug {name: "Copper"})-[r1:DRUG_PROTEIN]->(b:GeneProtein), (b)-[r2:PROTEIN_PROTEIN]->(c:GeneProtein), (c)-[r3:ANATOMY_PROTEIN_ABSENT]->(d:Anatomy) RETURN a, r1, b, r2, c, r3, d

Example 3:
User Query: "Which effect phenotypes are positively associated with the disease hyperemesis gravidarum?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:Disease {name: "hyperemesis gravidarum (disease)"})-[r:DISEASE_PHENOTYPE_POSITIVE]->(t:EffectPhenotype) RETURN s, r, t

Example 4:
User Query: "Which genes/proteins are part of the PI3K Cascade pathway?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:Pathway {name: "PI3K Cascade"})-[r:PATHWAY_PROTEIN]->(t:GeneProtein) RETURN s, r, t

Example 5:
User Query: "Which molecular functions are related to both '5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity' and 'methyltransferase activity'?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:MolecularFunction)-[r1:MOLFUNC_MOLFUNC]->(t1:MolecularFunction {name: "5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity"}), (s)-[r2:MOLFUNC_MOLFUNC]->(t2:MolecularFunction {name: "methyltransferase activity"}) RETURN s, r1, t1, r2, t2

Example 6:
User Query: "Which cellular components are associated with both the proteins ASDURF and PHYHIP?"
→ Cypher: MATCH (s:CellularComponent)-[r1:CELLCOMP_PROTEIN]->(t1:GeneProtein {name: "ASDURF"}), (s)-[r2:CELLCOMP_PROTEIN]->(t2:GeneProtein {name: "PHYHIP"}) RETURN s, r1, t1, r2, t2
